target: L003, second toroidal family, Section8 and Problem9.2

primary_source.title: Hexagonal extensions of toroidal maps and hypermaps
primary_source.read_scope: Previously inspected Eq2.3 and Section8 ordered presentations/Table8/Problem9.2. This package adds mathematical construction and does not claim a new literature search.

result: Finite regular rank-four hypertopes with exact local parameters ((3,0),(2,0),(1,1),(s,0)) for every integer s>=2.
new_construction: For s>=4 reduce the retained integral8D tensor marking modulo Fibonacci F_s. The new bounded-word membership theorem proves IP and typed coset Helly for all moduli>=5 and separately modulus3. Frozen parameter2/3 examples supply the remaining cases.
distinctions: All-integer finite regular existence is proved by the written construction and bounded certificate.
This does not claim universal finiteness; previously certified universal presentations are infinite at multiples of6.
No group-order or abstract-ambient identification is required or asserted for these tensor groups.
This is not whole-paper principal-results credit.
priority_status: Unverified. Retained bounded audits did not obtain the full 2024 Abelian covers of regular hypertopes article (DOI10.1016/j.jalgebra.2024.03.017); overlap of its general theorems remains undetermined. No novelty or infinity compression marker is claimed.
verification_boundary: The standard-library checker verifies literal finite algebra and complete local flag-count certificates. The all-modulus argument and geometry interpretation are written proofs, independently reviewed. No full Lean formalization.
